solutions.title: Start each unique window
solutions.strategy: Try each start index and extend until a duplicate appears.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each starting position can scan a suffix before stopping on a duplicate or the end.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The seen set stores at most one current duplicate-free window of k distinct characters.

solutions.title: Sliding window with last seen positions
solutions.strategy: Move the left boundary past the previous copy of the current character.

timeComplexity.explanation: The right boundary advances once per character and left only moves forward.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The map stores the latest index for each distinct character in the processed prefix.
